name: Overall
description: View overall rankings across AI models on front-end web development tasks, including agentic coding workflows

localizedDescriptions.en: A small tool for your own use to help you figure out "which AI channels/which models can still be used now". It automatically reads the AI ​​model configuration configured by Scripting, sends a real request one by one to detect the activity, directly marks the results with green dots/red dots, and gives the failure reason, response time and stability score.
